gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-miriam-libre: A towering x-height and almost sealed letter shapes give Capture It a hard, urban stamp, with no thick-thin flicker to soften it. Miriam Libre, a sans with open bends, runs across a page like fine wire.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Capture It stands tall and tightly shut, hard-edged and urban. Mochiy Pop One, a sans with a very large lowercase eye and letters hung like clothespins, loosens the page beneath that towering, commanding heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mochiy-pop-p-on: Wide gaps sit between every letter of Mochiy Pop P One, a sizable lowercase with no brush-like swell. Capture It is best at standing tall and commanding with nearly sealed shapes, while Mochiy Pop P One is best at staying clean and approachable.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-montserrat-unde: Capture It hits hard, tall and nearly sealed. Montserrat Underline, a sans-serif with breathing counters and round bowls of uniform wall, keeps a long page of text feeling open and unhurried.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mozilla-headlin: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal. Capture It holds the top with a pencil-line consistency and towering height, so the page moves from urban command into a friendlier, contemporary sans.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mozilla-text: Capture It keeps its joins full where strokes meet, and its letters stay nearly sealed under a towering x-height. Mozilla Text answers underneath with flared terminals and tall bodies that look bold, so the sans-serif below feels open against that tight heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-nata-sans: Nearly sealed letters under a towering x-height give Capture It its urban, commanding punch. Nata Sans does the opposite job, with a large central band and wide, unclosed curves that hold a steady technical-pen line in the text.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-nobile: Tall, tight and urban. Nobile, a sans-serif with minimal gap between x-height and caps and open mouths like an unjoined chalk arc, handles the text, while Capture It handles the shouting with its monoweight skeleton.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-nokora: Commanding and urban, Capture It sits tall with letters nearly sealed shut, and Nokora meets it with a wide-open s. Nokora is a plain sans, laying a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-kufi-arabi: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with an open, welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase. Over a long page, it stays a plain sans, while Capture It keeps its sealed, modulation-free heading letters tall above.
